Add an entry { file, rule, justification, addedBy, addedAt } where
justification names the PUBLIC benign constant by its meaning and its
file: repo-relative path, or a prefix ending with '*' to match all files under it.
rule: exact RuleId from scripts/security/secret-scan.ts, or '*' for all rules.
Entries are security-relevant changes and must go through review.
The two known-compromised-literal rules (C-045-a/C-045-b) are NEVER suppressible here.

allowlist.justification: Matched value (fingerprint a498…1775, len 66) is the Redeem module's custom ADMIN_ROLE hash — a PUBLIC on-chain role constant recorded in Task 11 D3 §2 (grant 0xa4980720…1775). A nearby word ('key' in prose) triggered key-context. Public constant, not credential material.

Matched value (fingerprint ac96…3a75) is the sha256 digest of audit-work/MTQ_SIGMA-unrtf.txt — VERIFIED this session by recomputing sha256 over the file (exact match). The manifest section heading 'sha256 of key sources' triggered key-context. Document digest, not credential material.

The scanner's own regression test embeds the BIP39 all-zero PUBLIC test mnemonic ('abandon … about') as a synthetic seed — a published test vector from the BIP39 reference test suite, not a real wallet's secret. The mnemonic-detection behavior itself is asserted via in-memory scanText calls and temp-dir scans, so suppressing this file's own seed does not weaken any tested rule.

SQLite DB backups (Task 16 / 16d-006) serialize the §24 audit-trail hash-chain columns (prevHash / rowHash / genesisHash) — 64-hex SHA-256 digests of canonical monetary state vectors. These are PUBLIC integrity-chain data by design (verifyAuditChain recomputes them from stored rows), not credential material. Verification basis: the backup manifest (BACKUP-MANIFEST-2026-10-23.md) documents per-table row counts; hash columns are the audit-trail schema fields. Scope is deliberately narrow: only this rule is suppressed for backups/ — every other rule (including both non-suppressible known-compromised-literal rules) still scans backups.

A checksums-manifest line ('digest  ./dumps/disk-latest-custom.sql') triggered key-context. Document digest, not credential material.

CLOUD DB LAYER (Task 38): the matches are PUBLIC on-chain ed25519 SIGNATURES in the logical chain.db dump — aggregate quorum-certificate signatures (blocks.qc JSON, one per block) and transaction signatures (txs.raw JSON 'sig' fields). Signatures are published consensus data by construction (every node and the explorer receives them). Verification basis: schema inspection PRAGMA table_info across all 13 chain tables + 11 custom tables shows NO private/secret/seed/mnemonic columns anywhere; devnet validator keys are derived at runtime from the committed public seed DEVNET_KEY_SEED (src/lib/chain/crypto.ts, INSECURE-BY-DESIGN testnet-only). Narrow scope: only this rule suppressed for the git-tracked dump path; all other rules still scan it.

LOCAL VAULT LAYER (Task 47): the matches are byte-copies of the git-tracked cloud dumps (backups/db-snapshots/latest-*.sql) placed in the disk vault mtq-sigma-backups/<stamp>-task47/ — the SAME PUBLIC on-chain data already allowlisted under backups/* (raw-64-hex): section-24 audit-trail hash-chain digests (prevHash/rowHash/genesisHash), QC/tx ed25519 signature material inside blocks.qc / txs.raw JSON, and block/state hashes. The vault directory is gitignored (/mtq-sigma-backups/* except manifests) and never committed; verification basis: the vault logical SQL files are cp(1) copies of the round-trip-verified dumps (db-restore-verify PASS, task47), and the schema basis of the backups/* entry applies unchanged (no secret columns in any chain/custom table). Narrow scope: only this rule suppressed for the vault path; all other rules (including both non-suppressible known-compromised-literal rules) still scan the vault.
